violation_type.title: Two Exits Located in Distant Parts (26 TAC §747.5011(a))
violation_type.short_title: Two Exits Located in Distant Parts
violation_type.typical_finding: The operation's daycare building is separate from the residence building. The daycare building does not have the required two exits. Windows that may count as a second exit for emergencies do not appear accessible enough for children and caregivers to exit safely and quickly.

finding_variants.text: The operation's daycare building is separate from the residence building. The daycare building does not have the required two exits. Windows that may count as a second exit for emergencies do not appear accessible enough for children and caregivers to exit safely and quickly.
The second exit at the operation was not able to be use it was blocked with fence boards on the ground.
The home had one approved exit, the exit in the back of the home was not easily accessible.
The caregiver could not open the exit door from backyard at inspection. The caregiver could only unlock the exit door from the outside of the house.
